cases.name: Audrey Kaylyn Adams
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Audrey grew up and attended school in Jennings, then later completed her education at Oilton. After high school, Audrey worked at TJ Maxx in Stillwater as a waitress and as a DoorDash driver.

Audrey enjoyed spending time at the lake and being with her family. She spent many hours watching makeup tutorials, tending to her cats, and, most of all, being with her son, Jax Ryker."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her in the head.
